title: Can I BEAT Crazyhouse Chess?
summary: Online Crazyhouse games vs ~1500 humans; captured pieces go to a pocket column at the left of the board and can be dropped.
rules: Captured enemy pieces switch colour and go into your pocket.
On your turn you may drop a pocket piece onto any empty square instead of moving.
Pawns cannot be dropped on rank 1 or 8.
Promoted pieces revert to pawns when captured.
Drops may give check or checkmate. Otherwise standard chess.
